quantize_model_with_4bit: quantize a huggingface model using 4-bit bitsandbytes quantization with Params4bit conversion
quantize_model_with_8bit: quantize a huggingface model using 8-bit bitsandbytes quantization with Int8Params conversion
replace_linear_with_bnb: replace all torch.nn.Linear modules in a model with bitsandbytes 4bit or 8bit linear modules
dequantize_bnb_weight: dequantize a bitsandbytes 4bit or 8bit weight back to a standard torch tensor
validate_bnb_backend: validate that available devices are supported by the installed bitsandbytes backend
